en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a small motor cargo ship named "JENJO" sailing close to a pier with a lighthouse at its end. The sea is calm with light waves, and a few crew members are visible on deck. The ship has a central mast with rigging and some bunting or signal flags hanging along the side. In the background to the right is a white lighthouse tower standing on a wooden or piled jetty extending into the water.
